title: Roles & access
description: Decide what people can do, then grant it — everywhere, for one department or for a single record.
systemRolesHint: Defined by modules and read-only. Duplicate one to customise it.

noCustomRoles.title: No custom roles yet
noCustomRoles.description: Bundle exactly the permissions a team needs into a role, then grant it to people or groups.

card.permissions: {count, plural, =0 {No permissions} one {# permission} other {# permissions}}
card.assignments: {count, plural, =0 {Not assigned} one {# active assignment} other {# active assignments}}

permissions.covers: {count, plural, =0 {matches nothing yet} one {covers # permission} other {covers # permissions}}
permissions.notHeld: You can’t grant this — you don’t hold it yourself.
permissions.selectAllHint: Selects {pattern} — includes permissions added to it later
permissions.patternHint: module.resource.action — use * for any segment, e.g. core.users.* or *.*.read.
permissions.patternInvalid: That isn’t a valid pattern. Use module.resource.action with optional * wildcards.
permissions.patternExists: This role already has that pattern.
permissions.patternNotHeld: You can only grant permissions you hold yourself.

form.createDescription: A role bundles permissions. Grant it to people or groups afterwards.
form.editDescription: Changes are recorded in the audit log.
form.name: Name
form.keyHint: A stable identifier used by integrations. Lowercase letters, digits, “-” and “_”.
form.permissionsHint: Start small — you can change permissions any time.
form.permissionsInvalid: One or more permission patterns are invalid.
form.selected: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}

grant.title: Grant a role
grant.description: Give a person or group the permissions in a role. Every grant is recorded in the audit log.
grant.principalType: Grant to a person or a group
grant.userHint: Only this person receives the role.
grant.groupHint: Everyone in the group receives the role — including people who join later.
grant.permanentHint: Access stays until someone revokes it. Prefer time-bound access for temporary needs.
grant.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Covering the service desk during the rollout (CHG-1042)
grant.reasonHint: Recorded in the audit log and shown to other administrators.
grant.limitScope: Limit to a department or record

scopeHint.department: Applies within the department and its sub-departments, for permissions that support department scope.
scopeHint.record: Applies to one record only (e.g. a single group), for permissions that support record scope.

validation.future: The end date must be in the future.

groupPicker.members: {count, plural, =0 {no members} one {# member} other {# members}}

revoke.title: Revoke {role} from {name}?
revoke.body: {name} loses the permissions in this role immediately. This is recorded in the audit log.
revoke.bodyGroup: Everyone in {name} loses the permissions in this role immediately, unless they have it another way. This is recorded in the audit log.

empty.title: No one has been granted a role yet
empty.description: Use “Grant role” to give a person or group access.
empty.filteredHint: Try a different search or clear the filters.

detail.notFound: This role doesn’t exist or was deleted.
detail.systemNotice: It’s defined by a module and kept in sync with it, so it can’t be edited. Duplicate it to make an editable copy.
detail.permissionsHint: Tick individual permissions, or select a whole module or resource to grant it with a wildcard.
detail.permissionsReadOnly: What anyone holding this role can do.
detail.unsaved: {count, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
detail.blocked: You can’t save this role because it includes permissions you don’t hold: {permissions}
detail.deleteBody: The role is removed permanently. This is recorded in the audit log.
detail.deleteBodyAssigned: The role and its {count, plural, one {# assignment} other {# assignments}} are removed permanently. This is recorded in the audit log.
detail.deleteWarning: {count, plural, one {# person or group} other {# people or groups}} will lose these permissions immediately.
detail.assignmentsHint: Active grants to people and groups.
detail.activityHint: Changes to this role, and who was granted it or lost it.
detail.deleteRequested: People can request this role. If anyone has requested it before, it can’t be deleted (the request history is kept): turn off “People can request this role” and remove its members instead.

errors.escalation: You can’t grant permissions you don’t hold yourself: {permissions}
errors.ownAdmin: You can’t remove your own platform administrator role — ask another administrator.
errors.offboarded: This person has been offboarded and can’t receive roles.
errors.systemReadOnly: System roles are defined by modules and can’t be changed.
errors.keyTaken: A role with this key already exists.

requestSettings.title: Self-service requests
requestSettings.description: Let people ask for this role in the request portal. Approved requests grant it automatically, and it expires on time.
requestSettings.requestableHint: It appears in the request portal. Access is granted when the approval workflow finishes.
requestSettings.notRequestableHint: Not in the request portal — only administrators can grant it.
requestSettings.riskHint: Shown to requesters and approvers. Workflows can route riskier requests to extra approvers.
requestSettings.ownerHint: Approves requests when the workflow has a role-owner step.
requestSettings.maxDurationHint: Requests can’t ask for longer than this. Grants made directly by administrators aren’t limited.
requestSettings.daysInvalid: Enter a whole number of days from 1 to 3650.
requestSettings.workflowHint: The workflow that handles requests for this role.

list.assigned: {count, plural, =0 {Not granted} one {# grant} other {# grants}}
